permits.description: remodel of existing 3-story with garage, 3 unit apartments including: creation of new ground floor living space for existing 2nd floor one unit, creation of new interior starway connecting existing 2nd floor one unit to new ground floor living space, creation of new 1 hour exit passageway

replace (e)masonry foundation walls adjacent to garage door, install steel moment frame around garage door opening, replace dry=rot damaged entry stair post supportingn 3/f bay, 50% dry rot repair of entry stair to address inadequate waterproofing.exterior finish at replmnt walls to match(e)stucco

service alley: relocated existing exterior surfaced-mounted elec.meters, move elec meters further toward oak st/front of bldg & locate inside a pg&e approved gyp.bd lined cabinet, no change to existing partial auto fire sprinkler system.

reconfigure (e) bath, enlarge (e) opening b/w living and kitchen, remove wall b/w kitchen and sunroom, refinish (e) floors, new paint, add new lighting , replace (e) side and rear metal windows with alum/clad in historic style, add new alum/clad wood window at rear patio, kitchen remodel in place.
revision to pa 2019-0719-6419 - relocation of (e) gas meters (inside garage) to bldg exterior on northeast side of bldg adjacent to service alley metal gate

garage - relocation of existing gas meters (in garage) to exterior service alley/exit passageway on ne corner of bldg. gas meters shall be installed within 1 hour fire rated, airtight & vented cabinet per pg&e standards
voluntary seismic strengthening of ground floor garage/storage areas including new wood frame shear walls and concrete footings.

remodel of (e) 3 unit. including : remodel of (e) interior stair from rear of one unit & replacement w/new exterior sprial stair down to rear yard, new 1-hr fire wall @ west prop. line, creation of roof deck for one unit @ rear, minor expansion of one unit. dining area into area of demolished #509
minor revision to pa#201402058987, interior remodel to revise kitchen layout, complete replace (e) #505 gas forced air heating system & relocate g/f utility room.

interior remodel of extg 3-story with garage, 3 unit apartment/one unit including. remodel of extg kitchen and 2 bathrooms. creation of master bedroom suite with new bathroom(within extg bedroom #2). removal/replacement of misc. interior non-load bearing partitions.
replace windows(4) on the side of the building same kind.
